svg.title: Azure DR workshop: deployed Korea Central / Korea South architecture
svg.desc: Verified v1.0.7 baseline. Priority DNS, two private AKS clusters, one RA-GRS account, PostgreSQL primary and geo-replica, metadata-only Event Hubs, active-geo Redis, independent Search, one private ACR, regional DNS and 17 private endpoints. DR role transitions have not been executed.
svg.text: Azure DR workshop | Korea Central + Korea South
Verified deployed baseline: drws1028c / v1.0.7 / 2026-10-28. Deployment and data checks passed; DR transitions not yet executed.
ARM control plane + approved client CIDR
No public release or local Docker Desktop
KRC priority 1 / KRS priority 2 | both Enabled + Online
DNS guidance only. The browser sends HTTP directly to the regional public IP.
App HTTP 80: approved IPs + TM probe
PaaS / ACR data paths remain private
DASHED BLUE = DNS ANSWER, NOT AN HTTP PROXY PATH
Live standby app; reachable for direct regional tests
MANAGED PAAS BELOW: ACCESSED VIA PE, NOT HOSTED INSIDE THE VNET
SAME STABLE BLOB PRIMARY / PG WRITER / EH ALIAS FROM BOTH APPS
Primary: read / write | 10 GB sample payload cap
Read-only secondary | NOT a second Storage account
General Purpose | stable writer / reader aliases
Geo-DR alias points to KRC at baseline
Old event payloads do NOT replicate to this namespace
Regional TLS client endpoint | active geo
Regional TLS client endpoint | active geo
Azure Container Registry | one private registry
Exact same package image in both AKS clusters | kubelet AcrPull
KRS pulls the KRC registry through Private Link
No second registry / no ACR geo-replication in this baseline
Log Analytics workspace + Azure Monitor PLS
Deployed in KRC RG | monitor PE in both VNets
Regional Private DNS and managed identities
Shared sample identity trusts both AKS OIDC issuers
One-command local deployment - no public release dependency
SHA verification - infrastructure - temporary mTLS builder - private image push - both apps - CLI 10 GB samples - replication / reads - smoke
Temporary builder, port 2376 rule, added push grant and certificates are REMOVED after transfer. No cloud Automation in this deployed path.
Planned DR is a separate approved exercise - NOT part of deployment validation
To KRS: Storage - EH - PG - TM. Back to KRC app: Storage - PG - EH active check - TM. EH stays in KRS; no former-primary failback.
Official Microsoft Azure icons (V24), used unchanged for architecture/training. Logical diagram; see architecture.md for scope, resource inventory and safety gates.
